title: Cloning a constraint experiment
statement: Let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment with variable set $V$, and let $M>0$ be a natural number. Its $M$-clone is the weighted constraint experiment on variables $V\times\text{Fin}(M)$ obtained by first sampling an outcome from $E$ and then independently choosing a uniformly random clone label in $\text{Fin}(M)$ for each query position. It retains the original predicate and replaces each queried variable by the pair of that variable and its chosen clone label.
